description: Send a fax to a US or Canada phone number. Accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, JPEG, TXT files (max 10) as base64-encoded content. Uses one page credit per page from the authenticated account, deducted when the fax is queued and returned if it fails to send; the account must have enough credits for the whole document.

fax_number.description: Destination fax number (10 digits, US or Canada)

notify_url.description: Optional URL to receive fax completion notification

name: send_fax
